title: Legal-aid applications in four districts, 2024
bodyMd: The table shows, for each of four judicial districts in 2024, the number of legal-aid applications received, the number granted, and the average number of days taken to decide an application. Every application received in 2024 was either granted or refused within that year.

data.caption: Legal-aid applications received, applications granted and average decision time in the districts of Arno, Brenta, Cesano and Dora during 2024.

accessibilityText: A table with four data rows and four columns: District, Applications received, Applications granted, and Average days to decide. Arno received 1,200 applications, granted 780, and averaged 42 days. Brenta received 900 applications, granted 720, and averaged 30 days. Cesano received 1,500 applications, granted 900, and averaged 55 days. Dora received 400 applications, granted 300, and averaged 20 days. The four districts together received 4,000 applications and granted 2,700. Every application received in 2024 was either granted or refused within that year, so the number refused in a district is its applications received minus its applications granted.

provenance.notes: Invented data for four fictional judicial districts. The figures were chosen so that every grant rate, every refusal count and the four-district total can be computed mentally without a calculator.
